Features

Mastery (Sap):

If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

Counter-Thrust

Reaction.

As a Reaction when a creature you can see hits you or an ally within your reach with an attack, you can raise your shield to intervene. Roll [[/r 1d8]] and add it to the target's AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. If this causes a melee attack to miss, you can immediately make one Lance attack against the attacker as part of the same Reaction.

▸ Upgrade — Perfect Offset

Your Counter-Thrust die increases to [[/r 1d10]]. Additionally, if an enemy's melee attack still hits an ally despite your Counter-Thrust, you can choose to physically step in the way. You take the damage instead of your ally, and you reduce the bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage taken by an amount equal to your total Armor Class.

Guard Dash

Bonus Action.

The lance is heavy, but you use your shield's momentum to push forward. As a Bonus Action, you can move up to 15 feet in any direction without provoking Opportunity Attacks, keeping your guard raised as you reposition.

▸ Upgrade — Leaping Thrust

When you use your Guard Dash Bonus Action, you can make one Lance attack at the end of the movement as part of the same Bonus Action.

Shielding Presence

You become a walking barricade. Allies within 5 feet of you gain the benefits of Half Cover (+2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws) as long as you are conscious and actively wielding the shield.

▸ Upgrade — Aegis Wall

Reaction.

Your Shielding Presence improves. Once per Long Rest, when you would make a Dexterity saving throw against an area effect while you are conscious and wielding the shield, you can use your Reaction to face the effect's origin and plant your shield as a barrier. You make a Constitution saving throw with Advantage against the effect's DC instead of a Dexterity saving throw.

This stance creates a 10-foot cone of cover behind you, originating from your space and pointing directly away from the effect's origin. You count as a wall between the effect and that cone.

When you use this Reaction, you can shout an order to each ally within 15 feet of you. Each of those allies can immediately use their Reaction to move up to half their Speed, provided they end this movement in the cone behind you. This movement happens before the effect resolves and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Each creature in the cone that is also in the effect's area can choose to make a Constitution saving throw with Advantage against the effect's DC instead of a Dexterity saving throw. A creature other than you that succeeds on this saving throw takes no damage from the effect, and a creature that fails takes only half as much damage.

Anchor Rage

Blocking heavy blows empowers your strikes. Whenever you successfully cause an attack to miss using your Counter-Thrust, your weapon absorbs the kinetic energy. Until the end of your next turn, your next successful Lance attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] piercing damage.
